name: Kyeryong Construction
verdict: Kyeryong Construction Industrial Co., a KOSPI-listed Daejeon builder whose largest shareholder is chairman Lee Seung-chan (38.49% including related parties, report of 5 June 2026). Nothing found.
note: Sleeve sponsor (sponsor patch) of Daejeon Hana Citizen 2026 home kit, per the club store's '2026 스폰서패치' product image. Rating note: ownership documented from the company's own disclosure (see claim). Quick company check (2026-09-30): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found. Not claim-worthy: the April 2023 Siheung MTV detour-road overpass deformation (Kyeryong was the builder) led to a 6-month business suspension and litigation, but no deaths or injuries and no human-rights finding.
